answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 35900 Country: India Title: Can we give sadaqah mutton to non-Muslims who are very needy? Question: Can we give sadaqah mutton to non-Muslims who are very needy? Answer ID: 35900 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 106/106/M=1433) The meat of nafl sadaqah may be given to a non-Muslim needy person. ولا تدفع إلى ذمى لحديث معاذ رضى الله عنه وجاز دفع غيرها و غير العشر والخراج إليه اى الذمي ولو واجباً كنذر وكفارة وفطرة فلاناً للثانى وبقولله يفتي حاوى القدسي (درمختار 3/301 زكريا) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
